files_or_snippet: src/token-stream.js (inspected in browser via GitHub blob view; no code copied)
how_adapted: Not adapted. Browser search (GitHub repository search for JavaScript math expression parsers) surfaced silentmatt/expr-eval as the closest candidate. Its tokenizer is tightly coupled to its own Parser/Token/operator-table framework and uses different unary-minus/precedence and error semantics than SPEC, so no code was copied. src/calc.js was written from scratch. Notes: no vendored code, so no src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md entry is needed.
